subject: Post-demo: Pilot triage and proposal for revised success gates
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@keenretail.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Pilot triage and proposal for revised success gates

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for joining the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kickoff: 

Summary of agreed baseline (from the call)
- Core scope: customer support triage + knowledge-base augmentation for the US e‑commerce storefront.
- Acceptance (initial): automated classification accuracy (macro F1) >= 0.78 on your labeled review set; average bot latency < 400ms P95.
- Data: you’ll provide a 10k anonymized sample of support tickets + KB snapshot by 2027-08-04.

Open asks / proposed clarifications
1) Ownership: we propose Camila as Redwood PM lead and Monica for onboarding/ingest; please confirm a Keen contact for data ingestion and a technical reviewer.
2) Evaluation cadence: ingest + baseline run (week 1), two-week evaluation window (weeks 2–3) with interim checkpoints.
3) Success measurement: we will include precision@1 and false positive rate as secondary metrics (suggested thresholds in attached spreadsheet).

Proposed timeline (subject to your confirmation)
- 2027-08-01: Pilot environment provisioned (Redwood Dedicated sandbox)
- 2027-08-04: Data drop from Keen (anonymized)
- 2027-08-08 to 2027-08-21: Eval window + daily sanity checks
- 2027-08-24: Wrap / go/no-go decision

Please see attached POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx for the initial measurement table.

If the above looks good, I’ll send a short mutual action plan and loop Procurement for the MPA.

Action items (for today)
- Sara / Tom: confirm Keen ingestion owner and procurement contact by EOD Fri 7/30
- Camila: prepare onboarding checklist and preflight tests
- Monica: confirm infra sizing and token budget for the trial environment

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@keenretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@keenretail.com>, procurement@keenretail.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Pilot triage and proposal for revised success gates

Thanks Rafael — the recap is accurate and helpful. A couple of requests coming out of our side: 

1) Add-on use case: our operations team would like us to validate a second micro-use-case during the pilot — structured invoice parsing (extract vendor, total, invoice date) from PDFs in parallel with triage. That will help our AP team evaluate ROI.

2) Timeline flexibility: if invoice parsing requires additional data prep, we may need a +1 week buffer on the evaluation window.

3) Compliance: Tom flagged SOC2 questionnaire items; attaching the questionnaire — can you confirm we have the right compliance reviewer on your side?

Procurement contact is procurement@keenretail.com (they’ve been CC’d). I’ll introduce an ingestion point person by EOD Friday.

—Sara

Attachments: keenretail-soc2-questions.pdf (pdf)
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@keenretail.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Pilot triage and proposal for revised success gates

On Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700 Sara Kim <sara.kim@keenretail.com> wrote:
> Thanks Rafael — the recap is accurate and helpful. A couple of requests coming out of our side: 
> 
> 1) Add-on use case: our operations team would like us to validate a second micro-use-case during the pilot — structured invoice parsing ...
>
Sara — thanks for the note. We can absolutely scope invoice parsing as a parallel validation stream. A few calls-to-action and proposed changes if Keen confirms: 

Scope changes (proposed)
- Keep the original support-triage evaluation as the primary success gate.
- Add a secondary invoice parsing stream: extraction accuracy (entity-level F1) target 0.82 on a 500-sample holdout set.
- New acceptance logic: primary gate must pass OR (primary marginal + invoice stream both exceed thresholds) — this avoids a hard fail if one stream underperforms.

Updated timeline (proposal)
- 2027-08-01: provision as planned
- 2027-08-04: data drop (support tickets + up to 800 invoice PDFs)
- 2027-08-08 to 2027-08-28: evaluation window (extended one week to accommodate invoice parsing)
- 2027-08-31: consolidated results and go/no-go decision

Ownership and tasks
- Redwood (Camila): ingestion templates for PDFs + tickets, invoice parsing baseline recipe, endpoint configs
- Redwood (Monica): infra provisioning and token budget management; sizing for PDF OCR pipeline
- Keen (Sara): secure data transfer + confirmed ingestion owner
- Keen (Tom): compliance reviewer for SOC2 items

I’ll update the attached scope-change-proposal.docx and the POC success spreadsheet with the new gates. Rafael — want me to send a formal re-baseline doc for signatures (DocuSign) once procurement confirms timeline?

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Product Lead, Pilots | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
From: Tom Li <tom.li@keenretail.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@keenretail.com>, procurement@keenretail.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Pilot triage and proposal for revised success gates

Thanks Camila — that sounds like a reasonable approach. A couple quick clarifications:

- For invoice PDFs: we can supply up to 600 labeled invoices for training and 500 for holdout; OCR is fine on our side but we’ll need a verification pass from you to confirm fields line up.
- Compliance: procurement will need a short answers sheet for SOC2 items (see attached). If you can provision the answers and a point-of-contact by 8/6, procurement can turn around MPA comments quickly.

We’re OK with extending the eval window one week — please go ahead and update the mutual action plan.

—Tom

Attachment: none (SOC2 questions previously attached)

Date: Tue, 09 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Re-baselined pilot plan, owners, and action tracker

Team / Keen —

Following the thread and our internal sizing review, here is the final re-baselined plan and immediate action tracker. This consolidates Camila’s proposal and Tom/Sara’s confirmations.

Key changes from original plan:
- Added secondary invoice parsing stream (entity F1 target 0.82) running in parallel with support-triage.
- Evaluation window extended by one week (now 2027-08-08 to 2027-08-28).
- Acceptance logic: pass primary triage gate OR pass both marginal primary thresholds + invoice stream threshold. Details in attached spreadsheet.

Owners and immediate actions:
- Camila (Redwood Product): upload ingestion templates and invoice baseline recipe to the shared Drive by 2027-08-03.
- Monica (Redwood Ops): provision Dedicated sandbox and OCR worker pool by 2027-08-01; confirm token budget (shared doc).
- Sara (Keen): supply anonymized support tickets + up to 600 training / 500 holdout invoices by 2027-08-04; confirm ingestion owner.
- Procurement@keenretail.com: review MPA and SOC2 answers — Redwood to provide SOC2 short answers by 2027-08-06 (Camila to own).

Attachments included in Drive: POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx, scope-change-proposal.docx, keenretail-soc2-questions.pdf

I’ve created a short mutual action plan in the Drive (link below) and will raise a DocuSign re-baseline once procurement confirms. Rafael — I assigned the DocuSign to you for signature routing.
